purpose: CozyV1 prototype; preserve Original and generated source PNGs

prompts.grass: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a cozy hand-painted 2D farming game with cute chibi characters, warm Japanese countryside animated-film atmosphere. Make ONE seamless square grass ground texture, 1024x1024, orthographic top-down, flat softly painted sage green meadow, subtle watercolor gouache variation and tiny sparse soft grass strokes. Very calm low contrast, understated warm yellow-green highlights. All four edges must tile seamlessly. Uniform distribution, no identifiable repeated flower clusters, no objects, paths, trees, houses, shadows, horizon, text or border. This is playable background, it must visually recede behind characters. No pixel art, no photographic detail.
prompts.tree: Use case: stylized-concept. Production cutout sprite of ONE mature round-canopied orchard tree for a cozy 2D farming game, warm hand-painted Japanese countryside animated-film atmosphere, cute chibi proportions. Full isolated tree, 3/4 overhead camera approximately 40 degrees looking down, front trunk visible with clear ground contact, broad rounded soft moss/sage green leaf masses with warm sunlit yellow tips, warm brown trunk, small red apples sparse and tasteful. Soft gouache watercolor with carefully defined silhouette; low contrast interior, beautifully readable and calm. Whole tree centered with generous transparent padding all sides, no grass patch, no landscape, no cast shadow outside tree, no outline glow/fringe, no text, no border, no other objects. True transparent background. Target silhouette roughly 3 times as tall as the game's farmer. All visible tree belongs to one sprite.
prompts.house: Generate a clean 2D game cutout of a small cozy chibi farmhouse. Absolutely TRANSPARENT empty background alpha=0, no background color, no backdrop, NO glow, NO halo, NO blur around silhouette, NO cast shadow. One cream plaster cottage with warm terracotta roof, timber accents, central welcoming wooden door and two windows, tiny front steps, one chimney. Gentle 3/4 overhead view for a farming game. Soft hand-painted gouache watercolor countryside animation style. Warm muted tones, clean isolated silhouette. Full building with generous empty transparent margins. No text or border. This must be a standalone sprite that can be composited directly onto a grass texture. Door one third of visible cottage height.
prompts.water: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE seamless square lake water ground texture for a cozy hand-painted 2D farming game, orthographic overhead. Soft clear light sky-blue and turquoise water, broad gentle flowing color variation, scattered subtle pale curved ripple lines and a few tiny reflected sun sparkles, very calm and low contrast. Warm watercolor gouache Japanese countryside animation atmosphere. Seamless edges in all directions. No shore, rocks, fish, land, text, border, horizon or perspective. Must read as a peaceful pond at small scale, not flat solid blue and not a dense repetitive pattern.
prompts.meadow: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE small irregular low meadow patch game cutout sprite with a few tiny cream daisies, soft yellow wildflowers, clover leaves and soft grass tufts. Cozy watercolor gouache Japanese countryside farming game, slightly overhead camera, warm sage and yellow green. Very sparse and low height, flowers much smaller than a chibi farmer's shoe, arranged asymmetrically as an organic patch. Clean isolated silhouette, transparent background everywhere between leaves and outside patch; no soil disk, no ground tile, no landscape, no glow/halo, no text, no frame, no border. Wide modest clump, generous transparent padding.
